preconditions.description: Number of planets, number of plans, and index of earth are within specified bounds.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in result) and len(result) == n
postconditions.description: Output is a list of n integers representing the minimum money needed to get from earth to each planet.
Minimum money to get from earth to earth itself is 0.
Each value in the result is either a non-negative integer or -1 if it's impossible to get to that planet.
